intake.title: Submit Legal Intake
intake.subtitle: Describe your legal inquiry. Review any draft summary and browse approved advocate profiles.
intake.categoryPlaceholder: Select legal issue category (e.g. Civil, Criminal, Family, Property)
intake.issueSummaryPlaceholder: Brief 1-2 sentence overview of your legal situation
intake.detailedDescriptionPlaceholder: Provide full facts, dates, parties involved, and any actions taken so far. Unicode text in all scheduled languages is supported.
intake.urgencyHigh: Urgent (Time-sensitive matter; no guaranteed emergency response)
intake.disclaimer: This intake does not constitute formal legal representation or create an advocate-client relationship until mutually accepted.
intake.confidentialNotice: Your intake details are encrypted and disclosed solely to authorized advocates upon consultation confirmation.
intake.successMessage: Your legal issue has been saved. You can now browse approved advocate profiles and request a consultation slot.
intake.reviewNotice: Draft summary will be reviewed prior to advocate consultation.

failure.genericError: An unexpected application error occurred. Please try again.
failure.networkError: Network connectivity error. Please verify your internet connection.
failure.unauthorized: Authentication required. Please sign in to access this feature.

voice.permissionDenied: Microphone access permission was denied by browser settings.
voice.speechNotVerifiedNotice: Browser speech recognition is unverified and may send audio to the browser or its speech service. Review and edit the returned text before adding it to intake. Vakil Setu does not store an audio recording.
voice.microphoneRequired: Microphone permission is required for speech input.
voice.unsupportedBrowser: Speech input is not available in this browser.

consent.termsBody: By using Vakil Setu, you acknowledge that this platform connects citizens with licensed advocates and does not itself provide legal advice. Information entered is confidential subject to applicable law.
consent.clientAdvocatePrivilege: Advocate-client confidentiality attaches upon formal bilateral consultation confirmation by both parties.
consent.emergencyDisclaimer: Vakil Setu is not an emergency legal dispatch service. For immediate crises or bodily harm threats, contact local law enforcement (112).
consent.aiPreliminaryNotice: AI summaries, when generated, are preliminary and unverified. Review and correct them before saving or sharing. They are not legal advice.
consent.agreeCheckbox: I have read, understood, and accept the platform terms and consent disclaimers.
consent.requiredConsentWarning: You must review and accept the consent disclaimers before submitting.

capabilities.truthfulNotice: All language and AI capability labels truthfully reflect current platform calibration.

productCopy.concernDescription: Include the facts, important dates, and what you need help with. Review the text before saving. This is a private intake, not a consultation request.
productCopy.reviewIntake: I reviewed and corrected this text. I want to save it to my private account.
productCopy.notSaved: This text has not been saved. Configure the services and sign in before saving.
productCopy.noTranslation: Language selection describes your text. It does not automatically translate it.
productCopy.voiceDisclosure: Your browser may send audio to its vendor’s servers for recognition. Vakil Setu does not store an audio recording. Recognition in your language depends on the browser and is not guaranteed. Typed input is always available.
productCopy.voiceConsent: I understand this browser processing and choose to use my microphone.

readAloud.label: Read aloud
readAloud.empty: Enter text before reading it aloud. If you recorded speech, add the reviewed transcript first.
readAloud.unavailable: Read-aloud is unavailable in this browser.
readAloud.noVoice: No local voice was found for the selected text language. Install a matching device voice to use read-aloud.
readAloud.ready: Ready to read this text using a local device voice. Pronunciation is unverified; remote voices are not used.
readAloud.bundledReady: Ready to read with the bundled local voice.
readAloud.bundledStarting: Preparing local speech… voice data is about 19 MB on first use.
readAloud.bundledDisclosure: Hindi and Punjabi use a synthetic voice inside your browser. Text is not sent to a speech service. Pronunciation is unverified.
readAloud.bundledError: Local speech could not complete. Check your connection while loading the voice files, then retry. No device voice installation is needed.
readAloud.bundledLimit: This text produces more than five minutes of audio. Use a shorter passage for local read-aloud; your text has not been changed.
readAloud.error: The device could not play this text. Check your audio output and installed speech voices, then try again.
readAloud.blocked: The browser blocked playback. Allow sound for this site, then click Read aloud again.

productCopy.headline: Your next step.
productCopy.heroDescription: Put your legal concern into words. Review a private summary. Connect with an approved advocate, at a time that works for you.
productCopy.intakeTitlePlaceholder: For example, a rental deposit concern
productCopy.intakeTextPlaceholder: Describe what happened and what you would like to understand…
productCopy.intakeStaysNote: Text stays in this browser page until you save.
productCopy.intakeRoleNote: Intake and case requests are available to user accounts.
productCopy.setupBody: Public information is readable. Sign-in, saved cases, advocate applications, and consultation requests need real Clerk and Convex configuration.
productCopy.setupNotSaved: Nothing entered here is saved to a server.
productCopy.accountDisabled: Your account is disabled. Private operations are unavailable.
productCopy.onboardingRoleFixed: Your account role is fixed after registration. Advocate accounts require a separate application and approval before appearing in discovery.
productCopy.followUpConsent: I reviewed this follow-up and want to append it to this case.
productCopy.summaryConsent: I have reviewed this summary and want to save a new version.
productCopy.aiConsent: I consent to send this saved intake and its saved follow-up context to Google Gemini for a private draft summary. I will review any result.
productCopy.cancelBeforeStart: Cancellation is available only before the slot start.
productCopy.selfDisableNote: You cannot disable your own administrator account.
productCopy.discoveryOrder: Results are ordered by earliest requestable slot, then name. Profiles without an open slot appear last.

caseCopy.savedBody: Below is exactly what you wrote. Nothing was added or changed.
caseCopy.noAnalysis: No AI summary has been saved.
caseCopy.nextOptions: Chat above, prepare a reviewed summary, or find an advocate.
caseCopy.yourWordsNote: Your words — review and shorten before sharing.
caseCopy.shortenSummary: Shorten your summary to 4,000 characters before saving. Your full intake stays saved.

chatCopy.title: Case discussion & preparation
chatCopy.description: Clarify your situation and prepare for consultation. Your original intake, recent conversation turns, and explicitly selected attachments are sent to Google Gemini for contextual assistance.
chatCopy.intakeDisclosure: Original intake, recent conversation, and selected files will be sent to Google Gemini. Uploaded files are stored privately in your case until explicitly selected for a message.
chatCopy.disclaimer: Preliminary informational help only. Does not constitute formal legal advice or guarantees. Please verify all guidance with an enrolled advocate.
chatCopy.turnsLimitReached: This case chat has reached the maximum of 100 turns. No more messages can be sent.
chatCopy.noTurns: No messages yet. Ask a question or share details about your case below.
chatCopy.documentsGuidance: Upload PDF, PNG, JPEG, or plain text (.txt) up to 3 MiB each (max 5 per case). Uploading stores files privately in your case. Files are never auto-sent: select the checkbox on any file to include it in your next message (max 3 files, combined up to 6 MiB).
chatCopy.noDocuments: No private documents uploaded for this case.
chatCopy.messagePlaceholder: Ask a specific question or describe changes in your legal situation…
chatCopy.consentLabel: I understand that my original intake, recent conversation, and selected documents will be sent to Google Gemini for assistance.

errors.emptyMessage: Please enter a message before sending.
errors.consentRequired: Consent is required before sending your message and attachments to Google Gemini.
errors.sendBusy: A message is currently being sent. Please wait.
errors.doubleSubmitPrevented: Submission in progress. Multiple clicks have been blocked.
errors.maxFilesReached: Limit reached: You can upload at most 5 documents per case. Remove a document first to add another.
errors.fileTooLarge: The selected file exceeds the 3 MiB limit. Please select a smaller file.
errors.invalidFileType: Unsupported file type. Only PDF, PNG, JPEG, and plain text (.txt) files are supported.
errors.uploadFailed: Document upload failed. Please try again.
errors.removeFailed: Could not remove document. Please try again.
errors.maxAttachmentsSelected: You can select at most 3 attachments per message.
errors.attachmentsTooLarge: The combined size of selected attachments exceeds 6 MiB. Deselect a file to continue.
errors.timeout: The AI reply took too long. Your case is saved. Review this message and send it again.
errors.in_progress: A message is currently being processed for this case.
errors.rate_limited: The service message limit was reached. Please wait before sending again.
errors.limit_exceeded: Chat or document limit reached. Please check document limits.
errors.provider_failed: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Review your message and send again.
errors.response_too_large: The model response exceeded the maximum size limit.
errors.blocked: The response was blocked by content safety filters.
errors.malformed: Received an invalid response from the AI provider.
errors.state_changed: Case state changed during processing. Please review and retry.
errors.generic: This request could not be completed. Your message has been preserved; you may retry.

intakeChatCopy.consent: Send my reviewed intake to Google Gemini to start a private chat. Replies may be wrong and require professional review.
intakeChatCopy.documents: You can upload PDF, JPG, PNG or TXT documents in your case chat after saving.
intakeChatCopy.failed: Your intake is saved, but the chat request could not be confirmed. Open your case to check or retry.
intakeChatCopy.initialMessage: Help me understand my saved concern and ask about any missing facts before suggesting next steps.

featureCopy.ratingCaveat: Feedback describes individual experiences. Ratings are not proof of legal competence or a guaranteed outcome.
featureCopy.publicNotice: Your rating and review text may be public after moderation. Do not include names, case facts, documents, contact details or other confidential information.
featureCopy.publicConsent: I understand this review is public and have removed confidential case information.
featureCopy.noEligible: Reviews are available after your consultation is completed.
featureCopy.summaryReview: Conversation text is a draft. Check every fact before saving or sharing your summary.
featureCopy.reportHint: Explain the abuse without repeating confidential case information.
featureCopy.noPublicReviews: No published feedback for this advocate yet.
